description: Environmental resources consumed, including air travel, chemicals, electricity, fuel, gas, water, and waste generated 2013-14 is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. The Environmental data includes energy consumed and generated as well as greenhouse gas emissions from Council's assets and a portion of its supply chain. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are assets, changemaker, energy, environment, ghg, green house gas. The portal shows 9,474 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
